effect.name: GM Turbulent Glass
effect.desc: Multi-octave procedural refraction for organic glass distortion.
effect.shader: float fundazGlassHash(vec2 p){return fract(sin(dot(p,vec2(127.1,311.7)))*43758.5453);}float fundazGlassNoise(vec2 p){vec2 i=floor(p),q=fract(p);q=q*q*(3.0-2.0*q);return mix(mix(fundazGlassHash(i),fundazGlassHash(i+vec2(1,0)),q.x),mix(fundazGlassHash(i+vec2(0,1)),fundazGlassHash(i+vec2(1,1)),q.x),q.y);}float fundazGlassFbm(vec2 p){return fundazGlassNoise(p)*0.6+fundazGlassNoise(p*2.03+7.1)*0.3*detail+fundazGlassNoise(p*4.01-3.7)*0.1*detail;} void main(){vec2 u=acScreenNorm;vec2 p=u*scale+phase;float e=0.02;vec2 g=vec2(fundazGlassFbm(p+vec2(e,0))-fundazGlassFbm(p-vec2(e,0)),fundazGlassFbm(p+vec2(0,e))-fundazGlassFbm(p-vec2(0,e)))/(2.0*e);gl_FragColor=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(u+g*amount,0.0,1.0));}
